title: Beat January next year: R500 a month #Savings
text:
In Wonga's survey, fewer than one in four people saved through the year for the festive season. R500 a month from January to December is R6,000 by Christmas, without touching your December pay. That's how a stokvel works. Saving on your own? Make it automatic: a separate savings pocket called "December" and a monthly transfer the day after payday. Money you never see is money you don't spend.

Full guide: "Festive Season on a Budget: How Not to Start January Broke (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
